## Mathematics
- **Batch 8:** verified the whole Weyl–Kac chain by derivation — the transverse-slice division and cone support, the Casimir exclusion (`β² = 2(ρ,β)` vs `β² ≤ 0 < 2(ρ,β)`), exponential weight symmetry, the dot-orbit numerator with `det(w)` coefficients, Kostant extraction, both specializations, and the counterexample/example computations (incl. the degree-2 denominator cancellation in the basic `sl₂` character). Also verified the loop/GCM isomorphism (Chevalley and Serre exponents, no stray central terms, kernel/Cartan argument) and the affine Weyl group translation formula.
- **Batch 9:** the one delicate step — `End_{H×H}(b) ≅ Z(b)` in `lem-block-induction-exists-under-centralizer-containment` (used to make `χ(T)=λ_b(rT|_b)` multiplicative) — I checked both by derivation and by direct machine computation in `F₂S₃` (`dim End_{S₃×S₃}(B₁) = 1 = dim Z(B₁)` for the non-local block `B₁ ≅ M₂(k)`), so the proof stands. The S₇ and SL₂(F_p) examples were recomputed in full.
- **Sources read:** Martínez (Thm 4.1/4.2/4.4/4.5, Lemma 3.8), Farrell–Lassueur (Remark 40.2, Prop 40.3, Thms 40.4/40.5, Cor 40.7), Saunders (Lemma 5.12(iii), 5.14, Example 5.15, Thms 5.16/5.17, Cor 5.19), Craven (Thm 1.12, §1.6 example). Honest limitation recorded in the report: I did **not** re-fetch the Kleshchev/Perrin PDFs; the Kac–Moody side was verified by derivation and by checking the internal published suppliers.
